edits.before: - Syndra Scatter the Weak (Stun): matchup-defining — The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. It governs your forward steps. - E Assassin's Path spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Scatter the Weak: 15s flat — the stun cone starts every kill combo; stay off the line between her and her orbs and commit while it's down. - Dark Sphere: 7s, her only poke — step up after she dumps it on the wave. - Unleashed Power: 120s at rank 1 — respect it, then all-in.

edits.before: Level 6 evens out: her R (Unleashed Power) is a huge point-and-click burst that can trade with your Shadow Assassin (R) engage, so it becomes a skill fight over who commits first. If she has spheres up and lands Q-E stun, her ult can delete you, but if you dodge the E your R all-in still wins. Play around her sphere count.
